fields.name: SyncedUpdateEntityUniqueID
fields.doc: SyncedUpdateEntityUniqueID  is the unique ID of the falling block entity that the block transitions to or that the entity transitions from if the block change entry is synced.

fields.name: SyncedUpdateType
fields.doc:
SyncedUpdateType is the type of the transition that happened. It is either BlockToEntityTransition, when
a block placed becomes a falling entity, or EntityToBlockTransition, when a falling entity hits the
ground and becomes a solid block again.

types.name: protocol.BlockEntry
types.doc:
BlockEntry is an entry for a custom block found in the StartGame packet. The runtime ID of these custom
block entries is based on the index they have in the block palette when the palette is ordered
alphabetically.

fields.name: Name
fields.doc: Name is the name of the custom block.

fields.name: Properties
fields.doc: Properties is a list of properties which, in combination with the name, specify a unique block.

types.name: protocol.BlockPos
types.doc:
BlockPos is the position of a block. It is composed of three integers, and is typically written as either
3 varint32s or a varint32, varuint32 and varint32.

types.name: protocol.BossKilledEvent
types.doc: BossKilledEvent is the event data sent when a boss dies.

fields.name: BossEntityUniqueID
fields.doc: BossEntityUniqueID ...

fields.name: PlayerPartySize
fields.doc: PlayerPartySize ...

fields.name: InteractionEntityType
fields.doc: InteractionEntityType ...

types.name: protocol.BoxShape
types.doc: BoxShape represents a box debug shape.

fields.name: BoxBound
fields.doc: BoxBound is the box bound of the shape.

types.name: protocol.CacheBlob
types.doc:
CacheBlob represents a blob as used in the client side blob cache protocol. It holds a hash of its data and
the full data of it.

fields.name: Hash
fields.doc:
Hash is the hash of the blob. The hash is computed using xxHash, and must be deterministic for the same
chunk data.

fields.name: Payload
fields.doc:
Payload is the data of the blob. When sent, the client will associate the Hash of the blob with the
Payload in it.

types.name: protocol.CameraAimAssistActorPriorityData
types.doc: CameraAimAssistActorPriorityData represents priority data for aim assist actor targeting.

fields.name: PresetIndex
fields.doc: PresetIndex is the index of the aim assist preset.

fields.name: CategoryIndex
fields.doc: CategoryIndex is the index of the aim assist category.

fields.name: ActorIndex
fields.doc: ActorIndex is the index of the actor.

fields.name: Priority
fields.doc: Priority is the priority value for this actor.

types.name: protocol.CameraAimAssistCategory
types.doc: CameraAimAssistCategory is an aim assist category that defines priorities for specific blocks and entities.

fields.name: Name
fields.doc: Name is the name of the category which can be used by a CameraAimAssistPreset.

fields.name: Priorities
fields.doc:
Priorities represents the block and entity specific priorities as well as the default priorities for
this category.

types.name: protocol.CameraAimAssistItemSettings
types.doc: CameraAimAssistItemSettings defines settings for how specific items should behave when using aim assist.

fields.name: Item
fields.doc: Item is the identifier of the item to apply the settings to.

fields.name: Category
fields.doc:
Category is the identifier of a category to use which has been defined by a CameraAimAssistCategory.
Only categories defined in the Categories slice used by the CameraAimAssistPreset can be
used here.

types.name: protocol.CameraAimAssistPreset
types.doc: CameraAimAssistPreset defines a base preset that can be extended upon when sending an aim assist.

fields.name: Identifier
fields.doc: Identifier represents the identifier of this preset.

fields.name: BlockExclusions
fields.doc: BlockExclusions is a list of block identifiers that should be ignored by the aim assist.

fields.name: EntityExclusions
fields.doc: EntityExclusions is a list of entity identifiers that should be ignored by the aim assist.

fields.name: BlockTagExclusions
fields.doc: BlockTagExclusions is a list of block tags that should be ignored by the aim assist.

fields.name: EntityTypeFamilyExclusions
fields.doc: EntityTypeFamilyExclusions is a list of entity type families that should be ignored by the aim assist.

fields.name: LiquidTargets
fields.doc: LiquidTargets is a list of entity identifiers that should be targetted when inside of a liquid.

fields.name: ItemSettings
fields.doc:
ItemSettings is a list of settings for specific item identifiers. If an item is not listed here, it
will fallback to DefaultItemSettings or HandSettings if no item is held.

fields.name: DefaultItemSettings
fields.doc:
DefaultItemSettings is the identifier of a category to use when the player is not holding an item
listed in ItemSettings. This must be the identifier of a category within the Categories slice.

fields.name: HandSettings
fields.doc:
HandSettings is the identifier of a category to use when the player is not holding an item. This must
be the identifier of a category within Categories slice.

types.name: protocol.CameraAimAssistPriorities
types.doc:
CameraAimAssistPriorities represents the block and entity specific priorities for targetting. The aim
assist will select the block or entity with the highest priority within the specified thresholds.

fields.name: Entities
fields.doc: Entities is a list of priorities for specific entity identifiers.

fields.name: Blocks
fields.doc: Blocks is a list of priorities for specific block identifiers.

fields.name: BlockTags
fields.doc: BlockTags is a list of priorities for specific block tags.

fields.name: EntityTypeFamilies
fields.doc: EntityTypeFamilies is a list of priorities for specific entity type families.

fields.name: EntityDefault
fields.doc: EntityDefault is the default priority for entities.

fields.name: BlockDefault
fields.doc: BlockDefault is the default priority for blocks.

types.name: protocol.CameraAimAssistPriority
types.doc: CameraAimAssistPriority represents a non-default priority for a specific target.

fields.name: Identifier
fields.doc: Identifier is the identifier of a target to define the priority for.

fields.name: Priority
fields.doc: Priority is the priority for this specific target.

types.name: protocol.CameraEase
types.doc: CameraEase represents an easing function that can be used by a CameraInstructionSet.

fields.name: Type
fields.doc: Type is the type of easing function used. This is one of the constants above.

fields.name: Duration
fields.doc: Duration is the time in seconds that the easing function should take.

types.name: protocol.CameraFadeTimeData
types.doc: CameraFadeTimeData represents the time data for a CameraInstructionFade.

fields.name: FadeInDuration
fields.doc: FadeInDuration is the time in seconds for the screen to fully fade in.

fields.name: WaitDuration
fields.doc: WaitDuration is time in seconds to wait before fading out.

fields.name: FadeOutDuration
fields.doc: FadeOutDuration is the time in seconds for the screen to fully fade out.

types.name: protocol.CameraInstructionFade
types.doc: CameraInstructionFade represents a camera instruction that fades the screen to a specified colour.

fields.name: TimeData
fields.doc:
TimeData is the time data for the fade, which includes the fade in duration, wait duration and fade out
duration.

fields.name: Colour
fields.doc: Colour is the colour of the screen to fade to. This only uses the red, green and blue components.

types.name: protocol.CameraInstructionFieldOfView
types.doc: CameraInstructionFieldOfView represents a camera instruction that updates the field of view.

fields.name: FieldOfView
fields.doc: FieldOfView is the field of view of the camera.

fields.name: EaseTime
fields.doc: EaseTime is the time in seconds that the easing function should take.

fields.name: EaseType
fields.doc: EaseType is the type of easing function used. This is one of the constants above.

fields.name: Clear
fields.doc: Clear can be set to true to clear the current instruction.

types.name: protocol.CameraInstructionSet
types.doc:
CameraInstructionSet represents a camera instruction that sets the camera to a specified preset and can be extended
with easing functions and translations to the camera's position and rotation.

fields.name: Preset
fields.doc: Preset is the index of the preset in the CameraPresets packet sent to the player.

fields.name: Ease
fields.doc: Ease represents the easing function that is used by the instruction.

fields.name: Position
fields.doc: Position represents the position of the camera.

fields.name: Rotation
fields.doc: Rotation represents the rotation of the camera.

fields.name: Facing
fields.doc: Facing is a vector that the camera will always face towards during the duration of the instruction.

fields.name: ViewOffset
fields.doc:
ViewOffset is an offset based on a pivot point to the player, causing the camera to be shifted in a
certain direction.

fields.name: EntityOffset
fields.doc: EntityOffset is an offset from the entity that the camera should be rendered at.

fields.name: Default
fields.doc: Default determines whether the camera is a default camera or not.

fields.name: IgnoreStartingValuesComponent
fields.doc: IgnoreStartingValuesComponent behavior is currently unknown.

types.name: protocol.CameraInstructionTarget
types.doc: CameraInstructionTarget represents a camera instruction that targets a specific entity.

fields.name: CenterOffset
fields.doc: CenterOffset is the offset from the center of the entity that the camera should target.

fields.name: EntityUniqueID
fields.doc: EntityUniqueID is the unique ID of the entity that the camera should target.

types.name: protocol.CameraPreset
types.doc: CameraPreset represents a basic preset that can be extended upon by more complex instructions.

fields.name: Name
fields.doc: Name is the name of the preset. Each preset must have their own unique name.

fields.name: Parent
fields.doc: Parent is the name of the preset that this preset extends upon. This can be left empty.

fields.name: PosX
fields.doc: PosX is the default X position of the camera.

fields.name: PosY
fields.doc: PosY is the default Y position of the camera.

fields.name: PosZ
fields.doc: PosZ is the default Z position of the camera.

fields.name: RotX
fields.doc: RotX is the default pitch of the camera.

fields.name: RotY
fields.doc: RotY is the default yaw of the camera.

fields.name: RotationSpeed
fields.doc: RotationSpeed is the speed at which the camera should rotate.

fields.name: SnapToTarget
fields.doc: SnapToTarget determines whether the camera should snap to the target entity or not.

fields.name: HorizontalRotationLimit
fields.doc: HorizontalRotationLimit is the horizontal rotation limit of the camera.

fields.name: VerticalRotationLimit
fields.doc: VerticalRotationLimit is the vertical rotation limit of the camera.

fields.name: ContinueTargeting
fields.doc: ContinueTargeting determines whether the camera should continue targeting when using aim assist.

fields.name: TrackingRadius
fields.doc: TrackingRadius is the radius around the camera that the aim assist should track targets.

fields.name: ViewOffset
fields.doc:
ViewOffset is only used in a follow_orbit camera and controls an offset based on a pivot point to the
player, causing it to be shifted in a certain direction.

fields.name: EntityOffset
fields.doc: EntityOffset controls the offset from the entity that the camera should be rendered at.

fields.name: Radius
fields.doc:
Radius is only used in a follow_orbit camera and controls how far away from the player the camera should
be rendered.

fields.name: MinYawLimit
fields.doc: MinYawLimit is the minimum yaw limit of the camera.

fields.name: MaxYawLimit
fields.doc: MaxYawLimit is the maximum yaw limit of the camera.

fields.name: AudioListener
fields.doc:
AudioListener defines where the audio should be played from when using this preset. This is one of the
constants above.

fields.name: PlayerEffects
fields.doc: PlayerEffects is currently unknown.

fields.name: AimAssist
fields.doc: AimAssist defines the aim assist to use when using this preset.

fields.name: ControlScheme
fields.doc:
ControlScheme is the control scheme that the client should use in this camera. It is one of the following:
 - ControlSchemeLockedPlayerRelativeStrafe is the default behaviour, this cannot be set when the client
   is in a custom camera.
 - ControlSchemeCameraRelative makes movement relative to the camera's transform, with the client's
   rotation being relative to the client's movement.
 - ControlSchemeCameraRelativeStrafe makes movement relative to the camera's transform, with the
   client's rotation being locked.
 - ControlSchemePlayerRelative makes movement relative to the player's transform, meaning holding
   left/right will make the player turn in a circle.
 - ControlSchemePlayerRelativeStrafe makes movement the same as the default behaviour, but can be
   used in a custom camera.

fields.name: ApplyInheritedStartingRotation
fields.doc:
ApplyInheritedStartingRotation specifies if the camera should start at the rotation of the preset it
inherits from, rather than at StartingRotation.

fields.name: StartingRotation
fields.doc: StartingRotation is the rotation that the camera starts at when the preset is applied.

types.name: protocol.CameraPresetAimAssist
types.doc: CameraPresetAimAssist represents a preset for aim assist settings.

fields.name: Preset
fields.doc: Preset is the ID of the preset that has previously been defined in the CameraAimAssistPresets packet.

fields.name: TargetMode
fields.doc:
TargetMode is the mode that the camera should use for detecting targets. This is one of the constants
above.

fields.name: Angle
fields.doc:
Angle is the maximum angle around the playes's cursor that the aim assist should check for a target,
if TargetMode is set to protocol.AimAssistTargetModeAngle.

fields.name: Distance
fields.doc:
Distance is the maximum distance from the player's cursor should check for a target, if TargetMode is
set to protocol.AimAssistTargetModeDistance.

types.name: protocol.CameraProgressOption
types.doc: CameraProgressOption represents a progress keyframe option for camera spline instructions.

fields.name: Value
fields.doc: Value is the progress value.

fields.name: Time
fields.doc: Time is the time for this progress option.

fields.name: EaseType
fields.doc: EaseType is the optional easing function name used to interpolate towards this progress key frame.

types.name: protocol.CameraRotationOption
types.doc: CameraRotationOption represents a rotation option for camera spline instructions.

fields.name: Value
fields.doc: Value is the rotation value.

fields.name: Time
fields.doc: Time is the time for this rotation option.

fields.name: EaseType
fields.doc: EaseType is the optional easing function name used to interpolate towards this rotation key frame.

types.name: protocol.CameraSplineDefinition
types.doc: CameraSplineDefinition represents a named camera spline definition.

fields.name: Name
fields.doc: Name is the name of the spline definition.

fields.name: TotalTime
fields.doc: TotalTime is the total time for the spline animation.

fields.name: SplineType
fields.doc: SplineType is the optional spline interpolation type.

fields.name: ControlPoints
fields.doc: ControlPoints is a list of points that define the spline curve.

fields.name: ProgressKeyFrames
fields.doc: ProgressKeyFrames is a list of progress key frames for the spline.

fields.name: RotationKeyFrames
fields.doc: RotationKeyFrames is a list of rotation key frames for the spline.

types.name: protocol.CameraSplineInstruction
types.doc: CameraSplineInstruction represents a camera instruction that creates a spline path for the camera to follow.

fields.name: TotalTime
fields.doc: TotalTime is the total time for the spline animation.

fields.name: SplineType
fields.doc: SplineType is the optional spline interpolation type.

fields.name: Curve
fields.doc: Curve is a list of points that define the spline curve.

fields.name: ProgressKeyFrames
fields.doc: ProgressKeyFrames is a list of progress key frames for the spline.

fields.name: RotationOptions
fields.doc: RotationOptions is a list of rotation options for the spline.

fields.name: SplineIdentifier
fields.doc: SplineIdentifier is an optional identifier for referencing the spline by name.

fields.name: LoadFromJson
fields.doc: LoadFromJson optionally determines whether the spline should be loaded from a JSON definition.

types.name: protocol.CarefulRestorationEvent
types.doc: CarefulRestorationEvent is an event sent by the server when a player performs a careful restoration.

types.name: protocol.CauldronInteractEvent
types.doc: CauldronInteractEvent is the event data sent when a cauldron is interacted with.

fields.name: BlockInteractionType
fields.doc: BlockInteractionType ...

fields.name: ItemID
fields.doc: ItemID ...

types.name: protocol.CauldronUsedEvent
types.doc: CauldronUsedEvent is the event data sent when a cauldron is used.

fields.name: Colour
fields.doc: Colour ...

fields.name: PotionID
fields.doc: PotionID ...

fields.name: FillLevel
fields.doc: FillLevel ...

types.name: protocol.ChainedSubcommand
types.doc:
ChainedSubcommand represents a subcommand that can have chained commands, such as /execute which allows you to run
another command as another entity or at a different position etc.

fields.name: Name
fields.doc: Name is the name of the chained subcommand and shows up in the list as a regular subcommand enum.

fields.name: Values
fields.doc: Values contains the index and parameter type of the chained subcommand.

types.name: protocol.ChainedSubcommandValue
types.doc: ChainedSubcommandValue represents the value for a chained subcommand argument.

fields.name: Index
fields.doc:
Index is the index of the argument in the ChainedSubcommandValues slice from the AvailableCommands packet. This is
then used to set the type specified by the Value field below.

fields.name: Value
fields.doc:
Value is a combination of the flags above and specified the type of argument. Unlike regular parameter types,
this should NOT contain any of the special flags (valid, enum, suffixed or soft enum) but only the basic types.

types.name: protocol.ChunkPos
types.doc: ChunkPos is the position of a chunk. It is composed of two integers and is written as two varint32s.

types.name: protocol.CodeBuilderRuntimeActionEvent
types.doc: CodeBuilderRuntimeActionEvent is an event sent by the server when a code builder runtime action is performed.

fields.name: Action
fields.doc: Action ...

types.name: protocol.CodeBuilderScoreboardEvent
types.doc: CodeBuilderScoreboardEvent is an event sent by the server when a code builder scoreboard is updated.

fields.name: ObjectiveName
fields.doc: ObjectiveName ...

fields.name: Score
fields.doc: Score ...

types.name: protocol.Command
types.doc:
Command holds the data that a command requires to be shown to a player client-side. The command is shown in
the /help command and auto-completed using this data.

fields.name: Name
fields.doc:
Name is the name of the command. The command may be executed using this name, and will be shown in the
/help list with it. It currently seems that the client crashes if the Name contains uppercase letters.

fields.name: Description
fields.doc:
Description is the description of the command. It is shown in the /help list and when starting to write
a command.

fields.name: Flags
fields.doc: Flags is a combination of flags not currently known. Leaving the Flags field empty appears to work.

fields.name: PermissionLevel
fields.doc:
PermissionLevel is the command permission level that the player required to execute this command. The
field no longer seems to serve a purpose, as the client does not handle the execution of commands
anymore: The permissions should be checked server-side.

fields.name: AliasesOffset
fields.doc:
AliasesOffset is the offset to a CommandEnum that holds the values that
should be used as aliases for this command.

fields.name: ChainedSubcommandOffsets
fields.doc:
ChainedSubcommandOffsets is a slice of offsets that all point to a different ChainedSubcommand from the
ChainedSubcommands slice in the AvailableCommands packet.

fields.name: Overloads
fields.doc:
Overloads is a list of command overloads that specify the ways in which a command may be executed. The
overloads may be completely different.

types.name: protocol.CommandEnum
types.doc:
CommandEnum represents an enum in a command usage. The enum typically has a type and a set of options that
are valid. A value that is not one of the options results in a failure during execution.

fields.name: Type
fields.doc:
Type is the type of the command enum. The type will show up in the command usage as the type of the
argument if it has a certain amount of arguments, or when Options is set to true in the
command holding the enum.

fields.name: ValueIndices
fields.doc:
ValueIndices holds a list of indices that point to the EnumValues slice in the
AvailableCommandsPacket. These represent the options of the enum.

types.name: protocol.CommandEnumConstraint
types.doc:
CommandEnumConstraint is sent in the AvailableCommands packet to limit what values of an enum may be used
taking in account things such as whether cheats are enabled.

fields.name: EnumValueIndex
fields.doc:
EnumValueIndex points to an enum value in the AvailableCommands packet that this
constraint should apply to.

fields.name: EnumIndex
fields.doc:
EnumIndex points to an enum in the AvailableCommands packet to which this
constraint should apply to.

fields.name: Constraints
fields.doc: Constraints holds a slice of constraints as present in the constants above.

types.name: protocol.CommandEnumContext
types.doc: CommandEnumContext holds context required for encoding command enums.

types.name: protocol.CommandOrigin
types.doc:
CommandOrigin holds data that identifies the origin of the requesting of a command. It holds several
fields that may be used to get specific information.
When sent in a CommandRequest packet, the same CommandOrigin should be sent in a CommandOutput packet.

fields.name: Origin
fields.doc:
Origin is one of the values above that specifies the origin of the command. The origin may change,
depending on what part of the client actually called the command. The command may be issued by a
websocket server, for example.

fields.name: UUID
fields.doc: UUID is a unique identifier for every instantiation of a command.

fields.name: RequestID
fields.doc:
RequestID is an ID that identifies the request of the client. The server should send a CommandOrigin
with the same request ID to ensure it can be matched with the request by the caller of the command.
This is especially important for websocket servers and it seems that this field is only non-empty for
these websocket servers.

fields.name: PlayerUniqueID
fields.doc:
PlayerUniqueID is an ID that identifies the player, the same as the one found in the AdventureSettings
packet. Filling it out with 0 seems to work.
PlayerUniqueID is only written if Origin is CommandOriginDevConsole or CommandOriginTest.

types.name: protocol.CommandOutputMessage
types.doc:
CommandOutputMessage represents a message sent by a command that holds the output of one of the commands
executed.

fields.name: Success
fields.doc:
Success indicates if the output message was one of a successful command execution. If set to true, the
output message is by default coloured white, whereas if set to false, the message is by default
coloured red.

fields.name: Message
fields.doc:
Message is the message that is sent to the client in the chat window. It may either be simply a
message or a translated built-in string like 'commands.tp.success.coordinates', combined with specific
parameters below.

fields.name: Parameters
fields.doc:
Parameters is a list of parameters that serve to supply the message sent with additional information,
such as the position that a player was teleported to or the effect that was applied to an entity.
These parameters only apply for the Minecraft built-in command output.

types.name: protocol.CommandOverload
types.doc:
CommandOverload represents an overload of a command. This overload can be compared to function overloading
in languages such as java. It represents a single usage of the command. A command may have multiple
different overloads, which are handled differently.

fields.name: Chaining
fields.doc: Chaining determines if the parameters use chained subcommands or not.

fields.name: Parameters
fields.doc:
Parameters is a list of command parameters that are part of the overload. These parameters specify the
usage of the command when this overload is applied.

types.name: protocol.CommandParameter
types.doc:
CommandParameter represents a single parameter of a command overload, which accepts a certain type of input
values. It has a name and a type which show up client-side when a player is entering the command.

fields.name: Name
fields.doc:
Name is the name of the command parameter. It shows up in the usage like <$Name: $Type>, with the
exception of enum types, which show up simply as a list of options if the list is short enough and
Options is set to false.

fields.name: Type
fields.doc:
Type is a rather odd combination of type(flag)s that result in a certain parameter type to show up
client-side. It is a combination of the flags above. The basic types must be combined with the
ArgumentTypeFlagBasic flag (and integers with a suffix ArgumentTypeFlagSuffixed), whereas enums are
combined with the ArgumentTypeFlagEnum flag.

fields.name: Optional
fields.doc:
Optional specifies if the command parameter is optional to enter. Note that no non-optional parameter
should ever be present in a command overload after an optional parameter. When optional, the parameter
shows up like so: [$Name: $Type], whereas when mandatory, it shows up like so: <$Name: $Type>.

fields.name: Options
fields.doc:
Options holds a combinations of options that additionally apply to the command parameter. The list of
options can be found above.

types.name: protocol.ComposterInteractEvent
types.doc: ComposterInteractEvent is the event data sent when a composter is interacted with.

fields.name: BlockInteractionType
fields.doc: BlockInteractionType ...

fields.name: ItemID
fields.doc: ItemID ...

types.name: protocol.ConeShape
types.doc: ConeShape represents a cone debug shape.

fields.name: Radii
fields.doc: Radii are the radii along the X/Z axes of the cone base.

fields.name: Height
fields.doc: Height is the height of the cone.

fields.name: NumSegments
fields.doc: NumSegments is the number of segments used for the cone.

types.name: protocol.ConsumeStackRequestAction
types.doc:
ConsumeStackRequestAction is sent by the client when it uses an item to craft another item. The original
item is 'consumed'.

types.name: protocol.CraftCreativeStackRequestAction
types.doc:
CraftCreativeStackRequestAction is sent by the client when it takes an item out fo the creative inventory.
The item is thus not really crafted, but instantly created.

fields.name: CreativeItemNetworkID
fields.doc:
CreativeItemNetworkID is the network ID of the creative item that is being created. This is one of the
creative item network IDs sent in the CreativeContent packet.

fields.name: NumberOfCrafts
fields.doc:
NumberOfCrafts is how many times the recipe was crafted. This field appears to be boilerplate and
has no effect.

types.name: protocol.CraftGrindstoneRecipeStackRequestAction
types.doc:
CraftGrindstoneRecipeStackRequestAction is sent when a grindstone recipe is crafted. It contains the RecipeNetworkID
to identify the recipe crafted, and the cost for crafting the recipe.

fields.name: RecipeNetworkID
fields.doc:
RecipeNetworkID is the network ID of the recipe that is about to be crafted. This network ID matches
one of the recipes sent in the CraftingData packet, where each of the recipes have a RecipeNetworkID as
of 1.16.

fields.name: NumberOfCrafts
fields.doc:
NumberOfCrafts is how many times the recipe was crafted. This field appears to be boilerplate and
has no effect.

fields.name: Cost
fields.doc: Cost is the cost of the recipe that was crafted.

types.name: protocol.CraftLoomRecipeStackRequestAction
types.doc:
CraftLoomRecipeStackRequestAction is sent when a loom recipe is crafted. It simply contains the
pattern identifier to figure out what pattern is meant to be applied to the item.

fields.name: Pattern
fields.doc: Pattern is the pattern identifier for the loom recipe.

fields.name: TimesCrafted
fields.doc: TimesCrafted is how many times the recipe was crafted.

types.name: protocol.CraftNonImplementedStackRequestAction
types.doc:
CraftNonImplementedStackRequestAction is an action sent for inventory actions that aren't yet implemented
in the new system. These include, for example, anvils.

types.name: protocol.CraftRecipeOptionalStackRequestAction
types.doc:
CraftRecipeOptionalStackRequestAction is sent when using an anvil. When this action is sent, the
FilterStrings field in the respective stack request is non-empty and contains the name of the item created
using the anvil or cartography table.

fields.name: RecipeNetworkID
fields.doc:
RecipeNetworkID is the network ID of the multi-recipe that is about to be crafted. This network ID matches
one of the multi-recipes sent in the CraftingData packet, where each of the recipes have a RecipeNetworkID as
of 1.16.

fields.name: FilterStringIndex
fields.doc: FilterStringIndex is the index of a filter string sent in a ItemStackRequest.

types.name: protocol.CraftRecipeStackRequestAction
types.doc:
CraftRecipeStackRequestAction is sent by the client the moment it begins crafting an item. This is the
first action sent, before the Consume and Create item stack request actions.
This action is also sent when an item is enchanted. Enchanting should be treated mostly the same way as
crafting, where the old item is consumed.

fields.name: RecipeNetworkID
fields.doc:
RecipeNetworkID is the network ID of the recipe that is about to be crafted. This network ID matches
one of the recipes sent in the CraftingData packet, where each of the recipes have a RecipeNetworkID as
of 1.16.

fields.name: NumberOfCrafts
fields.doc:
NumberOfCrafts is how many times the recipe was crafted. This field appears to be boilerplate and
has no effect.

types.name: protocol.CraftResultsDeprecatedStackRequestAction
types.doc:
CraftResultsDeprecatedStackRequestAction is an additional, deprecated packet sent by the client after
crafting. It holds the final results and the amount of times the recipe was crafted. It shouldn't be used.
This action is also sent when an item is enchanted. Enchanting should be treated mostly the same way as
crafting, where the old item is consumed.

types.name: protocol.CreateStackRequestAction
types.doc:
CreateStackRequestAction is sent by the client when an item is created through being used as part of a
recipe. For example, when milk is used to craft a cake, the buckets are leftover. The buckets are moved to
the slot sent by the client here.
Note that before this is sent, an action for consuming all items in the crafting table/grid is sent. Items
that are not fully consumed when used for a recipe should not be destroyed there, but instead, should be
turned into their respective resulting items.

fields.name: ResultsSlot
fields.doc:
ResultsSlot is the slot in the inventory in which the results of the crafting ingredients are to be
placed.

types.name: protocol.CreativeGroup
types.doc:
CreativeGroup represents a group of items in the creative inventory. Each group has a category, name and an
icon that represents the group.

fields.name: Category
fields.doc: Category is the category the group falls under. It is one of the constants above.

fields.name: Name
fields.doc: Name is the locale name of the group, i.e. "itemGroup.name.planks".

fields.name: Icon
fields.doc: Icon is the item that represents the group in the creative inventory.

types.name: protocol.CreativeItem
types.doc: CreativeItem represents a creative item present in the creative inventory.

fields.name: CreativeItemNetworkID
fields.doc:
CreativeItemNetworkID is a unique ID for the creative item. It has to be unique for each creative item
sent to the client. An incrementing ID per creative item does the job.

fields.name: Item
fields.doc: Item is the item that should be added to the creative inventory.

fields.name: GroupIndex
fields.doc:
GroupIndex is the index of the group that the item should be placed in. It is the index of the group in
the CreativeContent packet previously sent to the client.

types.name: protocol.CylinderShape
types.doc: CylinderShape represents a cylinder debug shape.

fields.name: RadiusX
fields.doc: RadiusX is the radius of the cylinder along the X axis.

fields.name: RadiusZ
fields.doc: RadiusZ is the radius of the cylinder along the Z axis.

fields.name: Height
fields.doc: Height is the height of the cylinder.

fields.name: NumSegments
fields.doc: NumSegments is the number of segments used for the cylinder.

types.name: protocol.DataStoreChange
types.doc: DataStoreChange represents a change to a data store property value.

fields.name: DataStoreName
fields.doc: DataStoreName is the name of the data store.

fields.name: Property
fields.doc: Property is the property that changed.

fields.name: UpdateCount
fields.doc: UpdateCount is the update count.

fields.name: NewValue
fields.doc: NewValue is the new property value.

types.name: protocol.DataStoreChangeEntry
types.doc: DataStoreChangeEntry represents a single entry in the data store changes array.

fields.name: ChangeType
fields.doc: ChangeType is the type of change. It is one of the DataStoreChangeType constants.

fields.name: Update
fields.doc: Update is set if ChangeType is DataStoreChangeTypeUpdate.

fields.name: Change
fields.doc: Change is set if ChangeType is DataStoreChangeTypeChange.

fields.name: Removal
fields.doc: Removal is set if ChangeType is DataStoreChangeTypeRemoval.

types.name: protocol.DataStoreMapEntry
types.doc: DataStoreMapEntry represents a key-value pair in a data store map property.

fields.name: Key
fields.doc: Key is the map key.

fields.name: Value
fields.doc: Value is the map value.

types.name: protocol.DataStorePropertyValue
types.doc: DataStorePropertyValue represents a typed property value in a data store.

fields.name: Type
fields.doc: Type is the property value type. It is one of the DataStorePropertyType constants.

fields.name: BoolValue
fields.doc: BoolValue is the value if Type is DataStorePropertyTypeBool.

fields.name: Int64Value
fields.doc: Int64Value is the value if Type is DataStorePropertyTypeInt64.

fields.name: DoubleValue
fields.doc: DoubleValue is the value if Type is DataStorePropertyTypeDouble.

fields.name: StringValue
fields.doc: StringValue is the value if Type is DataStorePropertyTypeString.

fields.name: ListValue
fields.doc: ListValue is the value if Type is DataStorePropertyTypeList.

fields.name: MapValue
fields.doc: MapValue is the value if Type is DataStorePropertyTypeMap.

types.name: protocol.DataStoreRemoval
types.doc: DataStoreRemoval represents a removal from a data store.

fields.name: DataStoreName
fields.doc: DataStoreName is the name of the data store being removed.

types.name: protocol.DataStoreUpdate
types.doc: DataStoreUpdate represents an update to a data store property.

fields.name: DataStoreName
fields.doc: DataStoreName is the name of the data store.

fields.name: Property
fields.doc: Property is the property being updated.

fields.name: Path
fields.doc: Path is the path within the property.

fields.name: ControlType
fields.doc: ControlType is the type of the data value. It is one of the DataStoreControl constants.

fields.name: DoubleValue
fields.doc: DoubleValue is the value if ControlType is DataStoreControlDouble.

fields.name: BoolValue
fields.doc: BoolValue is the value if ControlType is DataStoreControlBoolean.

fields.name: StringValue
fields.doc: StringValue is the value if ControlType is DataStoreControlString.

fields.name: PropertyUpdateCount
fields.doc: PropertyUpdateCount is the update count for the property.

fields.name: PathUpdateCount
fields.doc: PathUpdateCount is the update count for the path.

types.name: protocol.DefaultItemDescriptor
types.doc:
DefaultItemDescriptor represents an item descriptor for regular items. This is used for the significant majority of
items.

fields.name: Name
fields.doc: Name is the identifier of the item, such as minecraft:stone.

fields.name: MetadataValue
fields.doc:
MetadataValue is the metadata value of the item. For some items, this is the damage value, whereas for
other items it is simply an identifier of a variant of the item.

types.name: protocol.DestroyStackRequestAction
types.doc:
DestroyStackRequestAction is sent by the client when it destroys an item in creative mode by moving it
back into the creative inventory.

fields.name: Count
fields.doc: Count is the count of the item in the source slot that was destroyed.

fields.name: Source
fields.doc:
Source is the source slot from which items came that were destroyed by moving them into the creative
inventory.

types.name: protocol.DimensionDefinition
types.doc:
DimensionDefinition contains information specifying dimension-specific properties, used for data-driven dimensions.
These include the range (the height min/max), generator variant, and more.

fields.name: Name
fields.doc: Name specifies the name of the dimension.

fields.name: MinimumY
fields.doc: MinimumY is the lowest Y coordinate that exists in the dimension.

fields.name: HeightRange
fields.doc:
HeightRange is the number of blocks above MinimumY that exist in the dimension, so that the highest Y
coordinate in the dimension is MinimumY + HeightRange.

fields.name: Generator
fields.doc:
Generator is the variant of generator that exists in the provided dimension. These can be one of the constants
defined above. If this is set to GeneratorLegacy, the legacy horizontal world limits will be enforced.

fields.name: DimensionType
fields.doc:
DimensionType is the numeric identifier of the dimension. This cannot override a vanilla dimension (0-2), but
custom dimensions should start from 1000 like vanilla.

fields.name: PackID
fields.doc: PackID is the UUID of the behaviour pack which has added the dimension.

fields.name: DefaultBiome
fields.doc: DefaultBiome is the identifier of the biome that the dimension defaults to.

types.name: protocol.DropStackRequestAction
types.doc:
DropStackRequestAction is sent by the client when it drops an item out of the inventory when it has its
inventory opened. This action is not sent when a player drops an item out of the hotbar using the Q button
(or the equivalent on mobile). The InventoryTransaction packet is still used for that action, regardless of
whether the item stack network IDs are used or not.

fields.name: Count
fields.doc: Count is the count of the item in the source slot that was taken towards the destination slot.

fields.name: Source
fields.doc: Source is the source slot from which items were dropped to the ground.

fields.name: Randomly
fields.doc:
Randomly seems to be set to false in most cases. I'm not entirely sure what this does, but this is what
vanilla calls this field.

types.name: protocol.DynamicEnum
types.doc:
DynamicEnum is an enum variant that can have its options changed during runtime,
without sending a new AvailableCommands packet.

fields.name: Type
fields.doc:
Type is the type of the command enum. The type will show up in the command usage as the type of the
argument if it has a certain amount of arguments, or when Options is set to true in the
command holding the enum.

fields.name: Values
fields.doc: Values is a slice of possible options for the enum.

types.name: protocol.EducationExternalLinkSettings
types.doc: EducationExternalLinkSettings ...

fields.name: URL
fields.doc: URL is the external link URL.

fields.name: DisplayName
fields.doc: DisplayName is the display name in game.

types.name: protocol.EducationSharedResourceURI
types.doc:
EducationSharedResourceURI is an education edition feature that is used for transmitting
education resource settings to clients. It contains a button name and a link URL.

fields.name: ButtonName
fields.doc: ButtonName is the button name of the resource URI.

fields.name: LinkURI
fields.doc: LinkURI is the link URI for the resource URI.

types.name: protocol.EllipsoidShape
types.doc: EllipsoidShape represents an ellipsoid debug shape.

fields.name: Radii
fields.doc: Radii are the radii of the ellipsoid along the X, Y and Z axes.

fields.name: SegmentsPerAxis
fields.doc: SegmentsPerAxis is the number of segments used per axis for the ellipsoid.

types.name: protocol.EnchantmentInstance
types.doc:
EnchantmentInstance represents a single enchantment instance with the type of the enchantment and its
level.

types.name: protocol.EnchantmentOption
types.doc: EnchantmentOption represents a single option in the enchantment table for a single item.

fields.name: Cost
fields.doc:
Cost is the cost of the option. This is the amount of XP levels required to select this enchantment
option.

fields.name: Enchantments
fields.doc: Enchantments holds the enchantments that will be applied to the item when this option is clicked.

fields.name: Name
fields.doc:
Name is a name that will be translated to the 'Standard Galactic Alphabet'
(https://minecraft.wiki/w/Enchanting_Table#Standard_Galactic_Alphabet) client-side. The names
generally have no meaning, such as:
'animal imbue range galvanize '
'bless inside creature shrink '
'elder free of inside '

fields.name: RecipeNetworkID
fields.doc:
RecipeNetworkID is a unique network ID for this enchantment option. When enchanting, the client
will submit this network ID in a ItemStackRequest packet with the CraftRecipe action, so that the
server knows which enchantment was selected.
Note that this ID should still be unique with other actual recipes. It's recommended to start counting
for enchantment network IDs from the counter used for producing network IDs for the normal recipes.

types.name: protocol.EntityDefinitionTriggerEvent
types.doc: EntityDefinitionTriggerEvent is an event used for an unknown purpose.

fields.name: EventName
fields.doc: EventName ...

types.name: protocol.EntityDiagnosticTimingInfo
types.doc: EntityDiagnosticTimingInfo represents diagnostics for a specific entity type.

fields.name: DisplayName
fields.doc: DisplayName is the name to display for this timing entry.

fields.name: Entity
fields.doc: Entity is the identifier of the entity that is being timed.

fields.name: DurationNanos
fields.doc: DurationNanos is whole long the timing entry has lasted, in nanoseconds.

fields.name: PercentOfTotal
fields.doc: PercentOfTotal is the percentage of time that this timing entry has used compared to others.

fields.name: Position
fields.doc: Position is the position of the entity that is being timed.

fields.name: Dimension
fields.doc: Dimension is the name of the dimension that the entity being timed is in.

types.name: protocol.EntityInteractEvent
types.doc: EntityInteractEvent is the event data sent for entity interactions.

fields.name: InteractedEntityID
fields.doc: InteractedEntityID ...

fields.name: InteractionType
fields.doc: InteractionType ...

fields.name: InteractionEntityType
fields.doc: InteractionEntityType ...

fields.name: EntityVariant
fields.doc: EntityVariant ...

fields.name: EntityColour
fields.doc: EntityColour ...

types.name: protocol.EntityLink
types.doc: EntityLink is a link between two entities, typically being one entity riding another.

fields.name: RiddenEntityUniqueID
fields.doc:
RiddenEntityUniqueID is the entity unique ID of the entity that is being ridden. For a player sitting
in a boat, this is the unique ID of the boat.

fields.name: RiderEntityUniqueID
fields.doc:
RiderEntityUniqueID is the entity unique ID of the entity that is riding. For a player sitting in a
boat, this is the unique ID of the player.

fields.name: Type
fields.doc: Type is one of the types above. It specifies the way the entity is linked to another entity.

fields.name: Immediate
fields.doc:
Immediate is set to immediately dismount an entity from another. This should be set when the mount of
an entity is killed.

fields.name: RiderInitiated
fields.doc:
RiderInitiated specifies if the link was created by the rider, for example the player starting to ride
a horse by itself. This is generally true in vanilla environment for players.

fields.name: VehicleAngularVelocity
fields.doc: VehicleAngularVelocity is the angular velocity of the vehicle that the rider is riding.

types.name: protocol.EntityMetadata
types.doc:
EntityMetadata represents a map that holds metadata associated with an entity. The data held in the map depends on
the entity and varies on a per-entity basis.

types.name: protocol.EntityProperties
types.doc:
EntityProperties holds lists of entity properties that define specific attributes of an entity. As of v1.19.40, the
vanilla server does not use these properties, however they are still supported by the protocol.

fields.name: IntegerProperties
fields.doc: IntegerProperties is a list of entity properties that contain integer values.

fields.name: FloatProperties
fields.doc: FloatProperties is a list of entity properties that contain float values.

types.name: protocol.EnvironmentAttributeData
types.doc: EnvironmentAttributeData represents an environment attribute with optional transition data.

fields.name: AttributeName
fields.doc: AttributeName is the name of the attribute.

fields.name: FromAttribute
fields.doc: FromAttribute is the optional starting attribute for transitions.

fields.name: Attribute
fields.doc: Attribute is the current attribute value.

fields.name: ToAttribute
fields.doc: ToAttribute is the optional target attribute for transitions.

fields.name: CurrentTransitionTicks
fields.doc: CurrentTransitionTicks is the number of ticks elapsed in the current transition.

fields.name: TotalTransitionTicks
fields.doc: TotalTransitionTicks is the total number of ticks for the transition.

fields.name: EaseType
fields.doc: EaseType is the easing function used for the transition. It is one of the EasingType constants.

fields.name: LocalTransitionTicks
fields.doc: LocalTransitionTicks is the number of ticks elapsed in the local transition.

fields.name: NoiseTransition
fields.doc: NoiseTransition indicates whether the transition uses noise.

fields.name: NoiseAlignment
fields.doc: NoiseAlignment is the alignment of the noise used by the transition.

types.name: protocol.Event
types.doc:
Event represents an object that holds data specific to an event.
The data it holds depends on the type.

types.name: protocol.ExperimentData
types.doc: ExperimentData holds data on an experiment that is either enabled or disabled.

fields.name: Name
fields.doc: Name is the name of the experiment.

fields.name: Enabled
fields.doc:
Enabled specifies if the experiment is enabled. Vanilla typically always sets this to true for any
experiments sent.

types.name: protocol.ExtractHoneyEvent
types.doc: ExtractHoneyEvent is an event used to extract honey from a hive.

types.name: protocol.FishBucketedEvent
types.doc: FishBucketedEvent is the event data sent when a fish is bucketed.

types.name: protocol.FloatEntityProperty
types.doc: FloatEntityProperty is an entity property that contains a float value.

fields.name: Index
fields.doc: Index represents the index of the property. It is unclear what the exact purpose of this is.

fields.name: Value
fields.doc: Value is the value of the property.

types.name: protocol.FloatRange
types.doc: FloatRange is an inclusive minimum/maximum pair of float32 values.

fields.name: Min
fields.doc: Min is the minimum value of the range.

fields.name: Max
fields.doc: Max is the maximum value of the range.

types.name: protocol.FullContainerName
types.doc: FullContainerName contains information required to identify a container in a StackRequestSlotInfo.

fields.name: ContainerID
fields.doc: ContainerID is the ID of the container that the slot was in.

fields.name: DynamicContainerID
fields.doc:
DynamicContainerID is the ID of the container if it is dynamic. If the container is not dynamic, this
field should be left empty. A non-optional value of 0 is assumed to be non-empty.

types.name: protocol.FurnaceOptions
types.doc: FurnaceOptions holds the options that a player has selected in a furnace-like container's UI.

fields.name: LeftFurnaceTab
fields.doc:
LeftFurnaceTab is the tab that is selected on the left side of the furnace UI. It is one of the
FurnaceLeftTab constants above.

fields.name: Filtering
fields.doc: Filtering is whether the player has enabled the filtering between recipes they have unlocked or not.

fields.name: Layout
fields.doc: Layout is the layout of the furnace UI. It is one of the FurnaceLayout constants above.

types.name: protocol.GameRule
types.doc: GameRule contains game rule data.

fields.name: Name
fields.doc: Name is the name of the game rule.

fields.name: CanBeModifiedByPlayer
fields.doc: CanBeModifiedByPlayer specifies if the game rule can be modified by the player through the in-game UI.

fields.name: Value
fields.doc:
Value is the new value of the game rule. This is either a bool, uint32 or float32, or nil for the null
variant, which carries no value at all.

types.name: protocol.GatheringJoinInfo
types.doc: GatheringJoinInfo contains information about the gathering (experience) the player is joining.

fields.name: ExperienceID
fields.doc: ExperienceID is the UUID of the experience.

fields.name: ExperienceName
fields.doc: ExperienceName is the name of the experience.

fields.name: ExperienceWorldID
fields.doc: ExperienceWorldID is the UUID of the experience world.

fields.name: ExperienceWorldName
fields.doc: ExperienceWorldName is the world name of the experience.

fields.name: CreatorID
fields.doc: CreatorID is the ID of the creator.

fields.name: TargetID
fields.doc: TargetID is the session ID of the experience.

fields.name: ScenarioID
fields.doc: ScenarioID is the scenario ID of experience.

fields.name: ServerID
fields.doc: ServerID is the server identifier.

types.name: protocol.GenerationFeature
types.doc: GenerationFeature represents a world generation feature, used when encoding the FeatureRegistry to the client.

fields.name: Name
fields.doc: Name is the name of the feature.

fields.name: JSON
fields.doc: JSON is the encoded JSON data instructing the client on how to generate the feature.

types.name: protocol.HeightMap
types.doc: HeightMap holds the height of every column of a sub-chunk, indexed as [z][x].

types.name: protocol.InputFlags
types.doc:
InputFlags is the set of input flags in a PlayerAuthInput packet. It is sent as a list of the IDs of the
flags that are set, and is stored the same way, with the IDs kept unique.

The zero value has no size, so use NewInputFlags before setting a flag on it. Decoded values are always
sized.

types.name: protocol.IntegerEntityProperty
types.doc: IntegerEntityProperty is an entity property that contains an integer value.

fields.name: Index
fields.doc: Index represents the index of the property. It is unclear what the exact purpose of this is.

fields.name: Value
fields.doc: Value is the value of the property.

types.name: protocol.InvalidItemDescriptor
types.doc:
InvalidItemDescriptor represents an invalid item descriptor. This is usually sent by the vanilla server for empty
slots or ingredients.

types.name: protocol.InventoryAction
types.doc:
InventoryAction represents a single action that took place during an inventory transaction. On itself, this
inventory action is always unbalanced: It must be combined with other actions in an inventory transaction
to form a balanced transaction.

fields.name: SourceType
fields.doc: SourceType is the source type of the inventory action. It is one of the constants above.

fields.name: WindowID
fields.doc:
WindowID is the ID of the window that the client has opened. The window ID is not set if the SourceType
is InventoryActionSourceWorld.

fields.name: SourceFlags
fields.doc: SourceFlags is a combination of flags that is only set if the SourceType is InventoryActionSourceWorld.

fields.name: InventorySlot
fields.doc:
InventorySlot is the slot in which the action took place. Each action only describes the change of item
in a single slot.

fields.name: OldItem
fields.doc:
OldItem is the item that was present in the slot before the inventory action. It should be checked by
the server to ensure the inventories were not out of sync.

fields.name: NewItem
fields.doc:
NewItem is the new item that was put in the InventorySlot that the OldItem was in. It must be checked
in combination with other inventory actions to ensure that the transaction is balanced.

types.name: protocol.InventoryTransactionData
types.doc:
InventoryTransactionData represents an object that holds data specific to an inventory transaction type.
The data it holds depends on the type.

types.name: protocol.ItemDescriptor
types.doc:
ItemDescriptor represents a type of item descriptor. This is one of the concrete types below. It is an alias of
Marshaler.

types.name: protocol.ItemDescriptorCount
types.doc: ItemDescriptorCount represents an item descriptor that has a count attached with it, such as a recipe ingredient.

fields.name: Descriptor
fields.doc: Descriptor represents how the item is described over the network. It is one of the descriptors above.

fields.name: Count
fields.doc: Count is the count of items that the item descriptor is required to have.

types.name: protocol.ItemEnchantments
types.doc:
ItemEnchantments holds information on the enchantments that are applied to an item when a specific button
is clicked in the enchantment table.

fields.name: Slot
fields.doc: Slot is either 0, 1 or 2. Its exact usage is not clear.

fields.name: Enchantments
fields.doc:
Enchantments is an array of 3 slices of enchantment instances. Each array represents enchantments that
will be added to the item with a different activation type. The arrays in which enchantments are sent
by the vanilla server are as follows:
slice 1 { protection, fire protection, feather falling, blast protection, projectile protection,
          thorns, respiration, depth strider, aqua affinity, frost walker, soul speed }
slice 2 { sharpness, smite, bane of arthropods, fire aspect, looting, silk touch, unbreaking, fortune,
          flame, luck of the sea, impaling }
slice 3 { knockback, efficiency, power, punch, infinity, lure, mending, curse of binding,
          curse of vanishing, riptide, loyalty, channeling, multishot, piercing, quick charge }
The first slice holds armour enchantments, the differences between the slice 2 and slice 3 are more
vaguely defined.

types.name: protocol.ItemEntry
types.doc:
ItemEntry is an item sent in the StartGame item table. It holds a name and a legacy ID, which is used to
point back to that name.

fields.name: Name
fields.doc: Name if the name of the item, which is a name like 'minecraft:stick'.

fields.name: RuntimeID
fields.doc:
RuntimeID is the ID that is used to identify the item over network. After sending all items in the
StartGame packet, items will then be identified using these numerical IDs.

fields.name: ComponentBased
fields.doc: ComponentBased specifies if the item was created using components, meaning the item is a custom item.

fields.name: Version
fields.doc:
Version is the version of the item entry which is used by the client to determine how to handle the
item entry. It is one of the constants above.

fields.name: Data
fields.doc: Data is a map containing the components and properties of the item, if the item is component based.

types.name: protocol.ItemInstance
types.doc:
ItemInstance represents a unique instance of an item stack. These instances carry a specific network ID
that is persistent for the stack.

fields.name: StackNetworkID
fields.doc:
StackNetworkID is the network ID of the item stack. If the stack is empty, 0 is always written for this
field. If not, the field should be set to 1 if the server authoritative inventories are disabled in the
StartGame packet, or to a unique stack ID if it is enabled.

fields.name: Stack
fields.doc: Stack is the actual item stack of the item instance.

types.name: protocol.ItemStack
types.doc:
ItemStack represents an item instance/stack over network. It has a network ID and a metadata value that
define its type.

fields.name: BlockRuntimeID
fields.doc: BlockRuntimeID ...

fields.name: Count
fields.doc: Count is the count of items that the item stack holds.

fields.name: NBTData
fields.doc: NBTData is a map that is serialised to its NBT representation when sent in a packet.

fields.name: CanBePlacedOn
fields.doc:
CanBePlacedOn is a list of block identifiers like 'minecraft:stone' which the item, if it is an item
that can be placed, can be placed on top of.

fields.name: CanBreak
fields.doc: CanBreak is a list of block identifiers like 'minecraft:dirt' that the item is able to break.

fields.name: BlockingTick
fields.doc: BlockingTick is the tick at which a shield started blocking. It is only used for shield items.

types.name: protocol.ItemStackRequest
types.doc:
ItemStackRequest represents a single request present in an ItemStackRequest packet sent by the client to
change an item in an inventory.
Item stack requests are either approved or rejected by the server using the ItemStackResponse packet.

fields.name: RequestID
fields.doc:
RequestID is a unique ID for the request. This ID is used by the server to send a response for this
specific request in the ItemStackResponse packet.

fields.name: Actions
fields.doc:
Actions is a list of actions performed by the client. The actual type of the actions depends on which
ID was present, and is one of the concrete types below.

fields.name: FilterStrings
fields.doc:
FilterStrings is a list of filter strings involved in the request. This is typically filled with one string
when an anvil or cartography is used.

fields.name: FilterCause
fields.doc: FilterCause represents the cause of any potential filtering. This is one of the constants above.

types.name: protocol.ItemStackResponse
types.doc: ItemStackResponse is a response to an individual ItemStackRequest.

fields.name: Status
fields.doc:
Status specifies if the request with the RequestID below was successful. If this is the case, the
ContainerInfo below will have information on what slots ended up changing. If not, the container info
will be empty.
A non-0 status means an error occurred and will result in the action being reverted.

fields.name: RequestID
fields.doc:
RequestID is the unique ID of the request that this response is in reaction to. If rejected, the client
will undo the actions from the request with this ID.

fields.name: ContainerInfo
fields.doc:
ContainerInfo holds information on the containers that had their contents changed as a result of the
request.

types.name: protocol.ItemTagItemDescriptor
types.doc:
ItemTagItemDescriptor represents an item descriptor that uses item tagging. This should be used to reduce duplicative
entries for items that can be grouped under a single tag.

fields.name: Tag
fields.doc: Tag represents the tag that the item is part of.

types.name: protocol.ItemType
types.doc:
ItemType represents a consistent combination of network ID and metadata value of an item. It cannot usually
be changed unless a new item is obtained.

fields.name: NetworkID
fields.doc:
NetworkID is the numerical network ID of the item. This is sometimes a positive ID, and sometimes a
negative ID, depending on what item it concerns.

fields.name: MetadataValue
fields.doc:
MetadataValue is the metadata value of the item. For some items, this is the damage value, whereas for
other items it is simply an identifier of a variant of the item.

types.name: protocol.ItemUsedEvent
types.doc: ItemUsedEvent is when a player right clicks a item.

types.name: protocol.LabTableCombineStackRequestAction
types.doc: LabTableCombineStackRequestAction is sent by the client when it uses a lab table to combine item stacks.

types.name: protocol.LastShape
types.doc:
LastShape points to using the last shape settings.
If no shape has ever been set, then use the default one.

types.name: protocol.LegacySetItemSlot
types.doc:
LegacySetItemSlot represents a slot that was changed during an InventoryTransaction. These slots have to
have their values set accordingly for actions such as when dropping an item out of the hotbar, where the
inventory container and the slot that had its item dropped is passed.

types.name: protocol.LineShape
types.doc: LineShape represents a line debug shape.

fields.name: LineEndLocation
fields.doc: LineEndLocation is the line end location of the shape.

types.name: protocol.LocatorBarWaypoint
types.doc: LocatorBarWaypoint represents a waypoint entry in the locator bar packet.

fields.name: GroupHandle
fields.doc: GroupHandle is the UUID handle for the waypoint group.

fields.name: Waypoint
fields.doc: Waypoint contains the waypoint data.

fields.name: Action
fields.doc: Action determines the action for this waypoint. It is one of the WaypointAction constants.

types.name: protocol.MapDecoration
types.doc:
MapDecoration is a fixed decoration on a map: Its position or other properties do not change automatically
client-side.

fields.name: Type
fields.doc:
Type is the type of the map decoration. The type specifies the shape (and sometimes the colour) that
the map decoration gets. It is one of the MapDecorationType constants above.

fields.name: Rotation
fields.doc:
Rotation is the rotation of the map decoration. It is byte due to the 16 fixed directions that the
map decoration may face.

fields.name: X
fields.doc: X is the offset on the X axis in pixels of the decoration.

fields.name: Y
fields.doc: Y is the offset on the Y axis in pixels of the decoration.

fields.name: Label
fields.doc: Label is the name of the map decoration. This name may be of any value.

fields.name: Colour
fields.doc:
Colour is the colour of the map decoration. Some map decoration types have a specific colour set
automatically, whereas others may be changed.

types.name: protocol.MapTrackedObject
types.doc:
MapTrackedObject is an object on a map that is 'tracked' by the client, such as an entity or a block. This
object may move, which is handled client-side.

fields.name: Type
fields.doc: Type is the type of the tracked object. It is either MapObjectTypeEntity or MapObjectTypeBlock.

fields.name: EntityUniqueID
fields.doc: EntityUniqueID is the optional unique ID of the tracked entity.

fields.name: BlockPosition
fields.doc: BlockPosition is the optional position of the tracked block.

types.name: protocol.MaterialReducer
types.doc: MaterialReducer is a craft in a material reducer block in education edition.

fields.name: InputItem
fields.doc: InputItem is the starting item.

fields.name: Outputs
fields.doc: Outputs contain all outputting items.

types.name: protocol.MaterialReducerOutput
types.doc: MaterialReducerOutput is an output from a material reducer.

fields.name: NetworkID
fields.doc: NetworkID is the network ID of the output.

fields.name: Count
fields.doc: Count is the quantity of the output.

types.name: protocol.MemoryCategoryCounter
types.doc: MemoryCategoryCounter represents a memory usage counter for a specific category.

fields.name: Category
fields.doc: Category is the memory category. It is one of the MemoryCategory constants above.

fields.name: Bytes
fields.doc: Bytes is the number of bytes used by this category.

types.name: protocol.MineBlockStackRequestAction
types.doc: MineBlockStackRequestAction is sent by the client when it breaks a block.

fields.name: HotbarSlot
fields.doc: HotbarSlot is the slot held by the player while mining a block.

fields.name: PredictedDurability
fields.doc: PredictedDurability is the durability of the item that the client assumes to be present at the time.

fields.name: StackNetworkID
fields.doc:
StackNetworkID is the unique stack ID that the client assumes to be present at the time. The server
must check if these IDs match. If they do not match, servers should reject the stack request that the
action holding this info was in.

types.name: protocol.MismatchTransactionData
types.doc: MismatchTransactionData represents a mismatched inventory transaction's data object.

types.name: protocol.MoLangItemDescriptor
types.doc: MoLangItemDescriptor represents an item descriptor for items that use MoLang (e.g. behaviour packs).

fields.name: Expression
fields.doc: Expression represents the MoLang expression used to identify the item/it's associated tag.

fields.name: Version
fields.doc: Version represents the version of MoLang to use.

types.name: protocol.MobBornEvent
types.doc: MobBornEvent is the event data sent when a mob is born.

fields.name: EntityType
fields.doc: EntityType ...

fields.name: Variant
fields.doc: Variant ...

fields.name: Colour
fields.doc: Colour ...

types.name: protocol.MobKilledEvent
types.doc: MobKilledEvent is the event data sent when a mob is killed.

types.name: protocol.MultiRecipe
types.doc: MultiRecipe serves as an 'enable' switch for multi-shape recipes.

fields.name: UUID
fields.doc: UUID is a UUID identifying the recipe. Since the CraftingEvent packet no longer exists, this can always be empty.

fields.name: RecipeNetworkID
fields.doc:
RecipeNetworkID is a unique ID used to identify the recipe over network. Each recipe must have a unique
network ID. Recommended is to just increment a variable for each unique recipe registered.
This field must never be 0.

types.name: protocol.NoiseAlignment
types.doc: NoiseAlignment represents the way the noise of an environment attribute transition is aligned.

fields.name: Type
fields.doc: Type is the type of the alignment. It is one of the NoiseAlignmentType constants above.

fields.name: Value
fields.doc: Value is the value that the noise is aligned against, the meaning of which depends on Type.

types.name: protocol.NoiseBlockSpecifier
types.doc:
NoiseBlockSpecifier specifies a block placed by the gradient noise based on a threshold and
range.

fields.name: Noise
fields.doc: Noise is the noise name.

fields.name: Threshold
fields.doc: Threshold is the noise threshold above which the block is placed.

fields.name: Range
fields.doc: Range is the noise range within which the block is placed.

fields.name: Block
fields.doc: Block is the block runtime ID placed by this specifier.

types.name: protocol.NoiseDescriptor
types.doc: NoiseDescriptor describes the gradient noise used by a BiomeNoiseGradientSurface.

fields.name: Name
fields.doc: Name is the string used to initialise the noise.

fields.name: FirstOctave
fields.doc: FirstOctave is the first octave used by the noise.

fields.name: Amplitudes
fields.doc: Amplitudes is a list of amplitude values used by the noise. It must contain between 1 and 100 entries.

types.name: protocol.NormalTransactionData
types.doc:
NormalTransactionData represents an inventory transaction data object for normal transactions, such as
crafting. It has no content.

types.name: protocol.PackSetting
types.doc:
PackSetting represents a single setting from the pack settings UI. It holds information
about the setting that was changed, including its name and the new value.

fields.name: Name
fields.doc: Name is the name of the pack setting.

fields.name: Value
fields.doc: Value is the new value of the setting. This is either a float32, bool, string or []string.

types.name: protocol.ParameterKeyframeValue
types.doc: ParameterKeyframeValue represents a keyframe value for graphics parameters.

fields.name: Time
fields.doc: Time is the time for this keyframe.

fields.name: Value
fields.doc: Value is the value at this keyframe.

types.name: protocol.PatternRemovedEvent
types.doc: PatternRemovedEvent is the event data sent when a pattern is removed.

types.name: protocol.PersonaPiece
types.doc: PersonaPiece represents a piece of a persona skin. All pieces are sent separately.

fields.name: PieceID
fields.doc: PieceId is a UUID that identifies the piece itself, which is unique for each separate piece.

fields.name: PieceType
fields.doc: PieceType holds the type of the piece. This is one of the PieceType constants above.

fields.name: PackID
fields.doc: PackID is a UUID that identifies the pack that the persona piece belongs to.

fields.name: Default
fields.doc:
Default specifies if the piece is one of the default pieces. This is true when the piece is one of
those that a Steve or Alex skin have.

fields.name: ProductID
fields.doc:
ProductID is a UUID that identifies the piece when it comes to purchases. It is empty for pieces that
have the 'Default' field set to true.

types.name: protocol.PersonaPieceTintColour
types.doc: PersonaPieceTintColour describes the tint colours of a specific piece of a persona skin.

fields.name: PieceType
fields.doc:
PieceType is the type of the persona skin piece that this tint colour concerns. The piece type must
always be present in the persona pieces list, but not each piece type has a tint colour sent.

fields.name: Colours
fields.doc: Colours contains the four ARGB tint colours for the piece.

PlaceStackRequestAction is sent by the client to the server to place x amount of items from one slot into
another slot, such as when shift clicking an item in the inventory to move it around or when moving an item
in the cursor into a slot.

types.name: protocol.PlayerArmourDamageEntry

fields.name: ArmourSlot

fields.name: Damage

types.name: protocol.PlayerListEntry
types.doc:
PlayerListEntry is an entry found in the PlayerList packet. It represents a single player using the UUID
found in the entry, and contains several properties such as the skin.

fields.name: ActionType
fields.doc: ActionType is the action to execute upon the player list.

fields.name: UUID
fields.doc:
UUID is the UUID of the player as sent in the Login packet when the client joined the server. It must
match this UUID exactly for the correct XBOX Live icon to show up in the list.

fields.name: EntityUniqueID
fields.doc:
EntityUniqueID is the unique entity ID of the player. This ID typically stays consistent during the
lifetime of a world, but servers often send the runtime ID for this.

fields.name: Username
fields.doc:
Username is the username that is shown in the player list of the player that obtains a PlayerList
packet with this entry. It does not have to be the same as the actual username of the player.

fields.name: XUID
fields.doc:
XUID is the XBOX Live user ID of the player, which will remain consistent as long as the player is
logged in with the XBOX Live account.

fields.name: PlatformChatID
fields.doc:
PlatformChatID is an identifier only set for particular platforms when chatting (presumably only for
Nintendo Switch). It is otherwise an empty string, and is used to decide which players are able to
chat with each other.

fields.name: BuildPlatform
fields.doc: BuildPlatform is the platform of the player as sent by that player in the Login packet.

fields.name: Skin
fields.doc:
Skin is the skin of the player that should be added to the player list. Once sent here, it will not
have to be sent again.

fields.name: Teacher
fields.doc:
Teacher is a Minecraft: Education Edition field. It specifies if the player to be added to the player
list is a teacher.

fields.name: Host
fields.doc: Host specifies if the player that is added to the player list is the host of the game.

fields.name: SubClient
fields.doc: SubClient specifies if the player that is added to the player list is a sub-client of another player.

fields.name: PlayerColour
fields.doc:
PlayerColour is the colour of the player that is shown in UI elements, currently only used for the
player locator bar.

PlayerMovementSettings represents the different server authoritative movement settings. These control how

fields.name: RewindHistorySize

fields.name: ServerAuthoritativeBlockBreaking

ServerAuthoritativeBlockBreaking specifies if block breaking should be sent through

types.name: protocol.PotionContainerChangeRecipe
types.doc:
PotionContainerChangeRecipe represents a recipe to turn a potion from one type to another. This means from
a drinkable potion + gunpowder -> splash potion, and from a splash potion + dragon breath -> lingering
potion.

fields.name: InputItemID
fields.doc:
InputItemID is the item ID of the item to be put in. This is typically either the ID of a normal potion
or a splash potion.

fields.name: ReagentItemID
fields.doc:
ReagentItemID is the item ID of the item that needs to be added to the container in order to create the
output item.

fields.name: OutputItemID
fields.doc:
OutputItemID is the item that is created using a combination of the InputItem and ReagentItem, which is
typically either the ID of a splash potion or a lingering potion.

types.name: protocol.PotionRecipe
types.doc: PotionRecipe represents a potion mixing recipe which may be used in a brewing stand.

fields.name: InputPotionID
fields.doc: InputPotionID is the item ID of the potion to be put in.

fields.name: InputPotionMetadata
fields.doc:
InputPotionMetadata is the type of the potion to be put in. This is typically the meta of the
awkward potion (or water bottle to create an awkward potion).

fields.name: ReagentItemID
fields.doc:
ReagentItemID is the item ID of the item that needs to be added to the brewing stand in order to brew
the output potion.

fields.name: ReagentItemMetadata
fields.doc:
ReagentItemMetadata is the metadata value of the item that needs to be added to the brewing stand in
order to brew the output potion.

fields.name: OutputPotionID
fields.doc: OutputPotionID is the item ID of the potion obtained as a result of the brewing recipe.

fields.name: OutputPotionMetadata
fields.doc:
OutputPotionMetadata is the type of the potion that is obtained as a result of brewing the input
potion with the reagent item.

types.name: protocol.PresenceInfo
types.doc: PresenceInfo contains presence information about the experience.

fields.name: RichPresenceID
fields.doc:
RichPresenceID is the rich presence ID overriding the client-driven
rich presence.

types.name: protocol.PrimitiveShape
types.doc:
PrimitiveShape defines a single shape to be rendered on the client. Each shape has a unique NetworkID and a set of
optional parameters depending on its type.

fields.name: NetworkID
fields.doc: NetworkID is the network ID of the shape.

fields.name: DimensionID
fields.doc: DimensionID is the optional dimension ID where the shape is rendered.

fields.name: AttachedToEntityID
fields.doc:
AttachedToEntityID is the optional unique ID of the entity the shape is attached to. Mojang's documentation
describes it as a runtime ID, but the field is an ActorUniqueID and the client resolves it as one.

fields.name: Type
fields.doc:
Type is the type of the shape.
If not set, the set shape will be cleared.

fields.name: Location
fields.doc: Location is the location of the shape.

fields.name: Scale
fields.doc: Scale is the scale of the shape.

fields.name: Rotation
fields.doc: Rotation is the rotation of the shape.

fields.name: TotalTimeLeft
fields.doc: TotalTimeLeft is the total time left of the shape.

fields.name: MaxRenderDistance
fields.doc: MaxRenderDistance is the maximum distance the shape should render from the camera.

fields.name: Colour
fields.doc: Colour is the ARGB colour of the shape.

fields.name: ExtraShapeData
fields.doc: ExtraShapeData holding data specific to the type of shape (such as text string for the text shape).

types.name: protocol.PyramidShape
types.doc: PyramidShape represents a pyramid debug shape.

fields.name: Width
fields.doc: Width is the width along the X axis of the pyramid base.

fields.name: Depth
fields.doc: Depth is the optional depth along the Z axis of the pyramid base. It defaults to Width if unset.

fields.name: Height
fields.doc: Height is the height of the pyramid.
